current_detail: H1-R2.32 is the current physical working design without starting KiCad; its exact dual-RP GPIO0..47 electrical baseline remains the reviewed H1-R2.31 pin-map artifact. Front Hub RP uses 46 GPIO with reserves 6/47; rear RF RP uses 44 with reserves 15/29/37/38. The five Hub-RF signals bind exactly to M1 contacts 22/23/24/26/27 and RF GPIO19/25/26/24/27. Reset pulls, switched-domain off states, Hub 8/12 PIO plus 14/16 DMA, RF 6/12 PIO plus 12/16 DMA, four isolated audio directions, fail-disconnected S3 ROM-UART GPIO43/44, the C5 module-pad/IO-mux join, all five source-backed U219 active-package courtyards and all 43 existing Cap/evidence body coordinates are machine-checked. The complete physical mock-up still has three explicit blockers: exact U219 support-passive MPNs and courtyards, NFC pickup geometry, and installed-antenna swept volume, followed by explicit acceptance. Received-module/durability qualification remains H5/H7 work; live FSUSB42MUX/C11355 production routing, the service-VBUS detector/latch and the Pack/Safety powered-off-Ioff boundary remain fail-closed before a new R2 H2 export. Purchasing, KiCad and fabrication remain unauthorized.
